ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-20-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Petitioner: Matthew Fine, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Aisake Niutoni Fanaika Jr.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME

Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Laura Martinez.
Petitioner: Matthew Fine, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
After hearing the testimony by the Petitioner, matter is continued to Mar. 6, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for a letter from the Probation Officer consenting to the Petition for Name Change.
